grammar: tree-sitter-dart.wasm (pinned; Dart 3 class modifiers — abstract/base/interface/final/sealed — parse with zero ERROR nodes on the 400-file flutter sample)

heritage: mixins -> mixes_in (canonical, 2026-10-18; one row per applied mixin)

mixin_application_class.note: `class A = Base with M1, M2;` — the grammar puts the name inside mixin_application_class and leaves class_definition's name field empty

heritage: on-clause -> references{isMixinOn, typePosition: mixin_on_clause} (NOT extends, NOT mixes_in — a constraint, 2026-10-18)

extension_declaration.symbol: extension (NAMED: its name; UNNAMED: synthesized from the on-type, and the synthesized name is published as the extension's identity)
heritage: on-clause -> references (named extension: M -> OnType; unnamed: suppressed, the subject is its own identity)
representation_declaration field -> property (owned), NAME never a read
extension_type_declaration.note: DARTD21: before this dispatch the members surfaced as top-level symbols with no owner/contains

enum_declaration.members: enum_constant -> enum_member; enhanced enums also carry fields/methods/constructors in enum_body

enum_constant.note: DARTD22: the constant NAME is a declaration, never a read of its enum; its ARGUMENTS stay ordinary reads

types: the aliased type is a references position (e.g. typedef Alias = Point -> references Alias -> Point)
record-type RHS: field types publish references through record_type_field, fields have no declaration names (DARTGAP3 ruled)
type_alias.annotations: annotation parses INSIDE the type_alias wrapper -> references{annotatedKind: type_alias}

function_signature.symbol: function (top level) / method (class member, behind method_signature wrapper)

method_signature.note: wrapper: members arrive as class_body > method_signature (> function_signature|getter|setter|operator|constructor)

constructor_signature.symbol: constructor (the family name; namedSegment in metadata, isFactory for factories)
constructor_signature.note: DARTD3: constructors have no distinct name; DARTD20: last duplicate declaration wins

types: the field's declared type is a references position
multi-declarator: one symbol per name; annotation -> one row per declarator

static_final_declaration_list.note: `static final X = e;` is a DIFFERENT field shape from `final T x;` — DT-C1's containment oracle found 2 of 431 properties without it

local_function_declaration.note: DARTD8: not a symbol AND not a call-source context — nested lambda_expression > function_signature; calls inside fold into the enclosing function (csharp/python/go parity)

local_variable_declaration.note: bindings, never symbols; reads use the family binding spelling

initialized_variable_definition.note: binding declarator; declaration NAME is never a read (isDartDeclaredName gate)

library_name.symbol: module (the file's library identity: declared name, else stem; unnamed `library;` = stem with kind unnamed)
library_name.note: DARTGAP5 ruled: already read; DARTGAP6 no

library_import.relationship: imports -> the project-relative file path the specifier names when the checkout can answer, else `${uri}:*`; `importOutsideProject` claim where the checkout cannot contain it

part_of_directive.relationship: part_of{partRole: part}; the NAMED form (`part of my.lib;`, no URI child) publishes the declared library NAME with isNamedLibrary:true

annotation.relationship: references{relationshipType: annotation, isAnnotation, annotatedKind} from the DECORATED DECLARATION (or module/library) to the annotation TYPE
positions: child of class_definition / mixin_declaration / enum_declaration / extension_declaration / extension_type_declaration / enum_constant / formal_parameter / constructor_param / super_formal_parameter / local_variable_declaration / type_alias / library_name
sibling of the declaration inside class_body / program (modifier `*_builtin` nodes are stepped over: `@deprecated final x = 1;`)
annotation.target_rule: the `name` field: plain identifier as written; scoped_identifier -> LEAF when the qualifier is an IMPORT ALIAS, -> QUALIFIER when it is a type (`@TestFor.lint()` names TestFor; `@_i1.TestFor()` names TestFor)

type_identifier.relationship: references (gated on a type the run can see — same file, or projectIndex.typeKinds)

nullable_type.relationship: references via the inner type identifier; `Widget?` is the same declaration as `Widget`

function_type.relationship: references for parameter and return element types

record_type.relationship: references for each field TYPE (record_type_field / record_type_named_field)
record_type.note: DARTGAP3 ruled: no contains — record fields have no declaration names

void_type.note: `void` is not a type declaration; no edge

inferred_type.note: `var`/`final`-without-type = the absence of a written type; the initializer may CONSTRUCT one (assignment evidence for receivers), but no type mention

type_arguments.relationship: references for each argument type (`List<T>`); also the EVIDENCE for container element types used by receiver typing

type_parameters.note: DECLARES type variables; the mention of a variable is refused (isTypeParameterShadowed)

type_parameter.note: declaration site of a type variable — never a mention

qualified.relationship: uses as a member read under a constant_pattern / object_pattern test (`case M.off:`); type_identifier leaf -> references in type positions

scoped_identifier.relationship: annotation target spelling (alias-vs-type rule); type positions resolve to the LEAF

representation type.relationship: references? — the extension type's representation type is a type mention (position table: representation_declaration)

selector_with_argument_part.relationship: calls -> leaf callee (chain reduces to the last link); capitalized callee -> instantiates

selector_without_argument_part.relationship: uses member read (`obj.method` tear-off, this.count, C.total); LHS of plain `=` is a write, not a read

new_expression.relationship: instantiates (grammar keeps it only under an explicit `new`)

constructor_tearoff.relationship: references -> the type (expression position, typePosition constructor_tearoff); in a const pattern `X.new` -> instantiates with isConstructorReference

cascade_section.relationship: calls/uses per section leaf (DARTD17: b..a.b.c(1) calls c)

template_substitution.relationship: uses per identifier inside `${...}` (member reads keep the member spelling)

list_literal.relationship: element values are ordinary reads; a generic literal's type arguments are type mentions

record_literal.relationship: NO symbol, NO contains; the literal's field READS publish as member reads (`rec.$1` -> uses -> $1 with receiverTypeUnknown; DARTGAP4 ruled)

constant_pattern.relationship: uses{isConstantPattern} — qualified form (pre-existing arm); bare/null-check/null-assert/relational/collection forms -> uses{isConstantPattern,isPatternTest} (DARTGAP2)

relational_operand.relationship: uses{isPatternTest} — the grammar gives the operand NO wrapper node; a bare identifier or qualified constant is the pattern test

variable_pattern.relationship: binding (no symbol); its reads publish uses with the family binding spelling

rest_pattern.relationship: binding — `...rest` binds a name (DARTGAP1's real missing edge before 2026-10-18); measured zero occurrences on ProxiCall/lib, so the closure measurement names that population

object_pattern.relationship: the pattern's TYPE is a references mention; the GETTER LABELS are deliberately NOT emitted (a structural member test with no in-file declaration — named as non-emission in DARTGAP2)

record_pattern.relationship: structural bindings are bindings; constants inside are pattern tests

object_pattern_getter_label.note: TOP-DO: a receiver-typed object-pattern test (`String(length: final len)` -> String.length) would be a NEW measured item, not a hole in DARTGAP2 as scoped

identifier_bare_read.relationship: uses — member read of the enclosing type (0.6 isBareRead), file-scope value (0.9 isGlobalRead), or local/parameter binding (binding spelling)

interpolation_exports.relationship: uses per read; local DECLARATORs suppress, PARAMETERS do not

assignment_expression.relationship: plain `=` LHS is a write (no read); compound assignments read

throw_expression.relationship: the thrown value is a read; exception types of catch clauses type their bindings

for_loop_parts_untyped.relationship: the loop variable's ELEMENT type is inferred from the iterable's written type argument for the loop body (receiver typing); no written type -> no inference

dart_only_constructs._description: The constructs this task singles out — each with its emitted relationship or its RULED non-emission, and the fixture that can go RED.

with_mixin_application.emission: mixes_in (all three sites: extends A with M, class A with M, class C = Base with M1, M2; enhanced enum with too)
with_mixin_application.before: uses{isMixin:true} (ad-hoc flag on the wrong label)

part_of_directive.emission: part_of{partRole: part}; NAMED form -> library name with isNamedLibrary
part_of_directive.before: imports{isPart,isPartOf}; the NAMED form emitted NOTHING

metadata_annotations.emission: references{isAnnotation, annotatedKind} from the decorated declaration/library; 16 positions

extension_on_types.emission: references (named extension's target); unnamed extension's subject is its OWN identity

show_hide_combinators.ruled: NO relationship owed: a combinator names declarations in ANOTHER file (not a declaration here, not a type mention); the import/export edge already carries the dependency. Recorded rather than silently dropped.

receiver_owner_channel.emission: calls/uses metadata.owner + ownerEvidence{param,field,annotation,assignment}; only class-like or externally-declared types (a mixin/extension/typedef owner makes the resolver withdraw, so it is withheld)
receiver_owner_channel.before: no owner metadata; store resolved by name counts only

type_aliases.emission: type symbol + references for the aliased type; typedef over record -> field-type references, not contains

_notes.provenance: Every entry above is implemented in src/ast/real-dart-analyzer.ts and pinned by the named fixture(s) in validation/m14/fixtures/dart/; a fixture pin is written so a regression makes it RED (positive row + at least one forbid of the superseded shape). The spec table was written from the pinned grammar (shape probes are committed: pattern-forms-probe.ts, annotation-shapes-probe.ts, _tree-probe.ts) and from the corpus-measured behaviour, not from the Dart spec alone.
_notes.matrix_columns: The ten canonical matrix types are a SUBSET: this lane also emits mixes_in, part_of, and annotation references (the owner-ruled complete surface).
_notes.d1_status: D1 requires every relationship type the language can express to be enumerated WITH its implementation site and a red-capable fixture: this file is that enumeration for dart. The relationship-TYPE table with implementation+fixture columns is DART-APPLICABLE-SET.md §1-§2.
known_non_emissions: object-pattern getter labels (structural member test; would need receiver-typed pattern tests) — named, not silent
function_expression / lambda_expression bodies as symbol scopes (DARTD2/DARTD8 family contract)
